description: Test suite for BoringSSL's CRYPTO_BUFFER pooling, including reference counting, pooling behavior, and thread safety.

methods.name: Unpooled
methods.description: Tests creating and reference counting of unpooled CRYPTO_BUFFER objects.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Tests creating a CRYPTO_BUFFER with null data and size zero.

methods.name: Pooled
methods.description: Tests pooling behavior, deduplication, and static buffer participation.

methods.name: Threads
methods.description: Tests thread safety and concurrent access to pooled CRYPTO_BUFFER objects.
